title: Reassessing Lightweight CNN Architectures for Cotton Leaf Disease Recognition: code and results
description: Training notebook, analysis scripts and complete per-run results (30 models: 2 data splits x 3 backbones x 5 seeds) for a reproducible comparison of MobileNetV3Small, EfficientNetB0 and DenseNet121 on the Cotton Disease Dataset, including a perceptual-hash duplicate audit, hierarchical-bootstrap statistics, Grad-CAM faithfulness evaluation, and a dataset-free demonstration of a Keras 3 BatchNorm training-mode pitfall.
